scope: R0 search for original MD-2S executable solver, parameters, profiles, one-sided boundary data, residual logs and provenance manifests

search_channels.result: No executable MD-2S solver, notebook, one-sided derivative export or residual log was identified in the indexed repository content or the targeted MD-2S/SCI-001/SCI-002 commit history.
search_channels.limitations: Repository code-search coverage may be incomplete; the result is limited to accessible repository and commit content.

search_channels.result: The package contains 141 conversations, including 69 Hyperzeit-classified conversations, with the latest update on 2025-12-17. Exact message-text searches found no MD-2S, B1.4N, B1.4O or registered A0 benchmark values. The package therefore predates the 2026 MD-2S work and cannot contain its later solver run unless an older attachment binary were separately preserved.
search_channels.limitations: The export preserves attachment metadata names but not the referenced historical attachment binaries. Negative message-text search is not a global proof of non-existence outside the archive.

search_channels.result: The archive contains 40 PDF files and no Python, notebook, CSV, JSON, solver-input, solver-output, residual-log or SHA-256 run-manifest artifact. The chat PDFs refer to such packages, but the packages themselves are absent.
search_channels.limitations: The PDFs preserve development history and reported numerical results, not executable computation.

search_channels.result: Targeted searches recovered the Hyper.zip analysis, the 2026-07-31 Hyperzeit project-status HTML export, MD-0 documents, export manifests and unrelated later COS-04 Python tools. No MD-2S background solver, one-sided cap export or residual package was identified.
search_channels.limitations: File search is semantic/index based and is not a byte-level traversal of every stored binary.

search_channels.result: The export contains 1109 File-Library records, but 711 records lack an exactly same-named binary match in the exported binary inventory. Therefore absence from the indexed corpus does not prove global non-existence.
search_channels.limitations: The unmatched records require a separate byte-level mapping of the combined export and File-Library metadata.

search_channels.result: All 27 split parts and the combined export are hash-registered. The combined archive chatgpt_export_combined.zip has SHA-256 851def1c10dc3dbcc2041eff14422794d1c39e6330b8cd2a636fab4630dd7d00.
search_channels.limitations: The hash proves identity of the export archive, not the presence of an MD-2S solver inside it.

latest_archived_md2s_result.result: The unrestricted linear system is algebraically solvable only by using a conical centre mode. With a fixed smooth centre and the minimal cap controls, no global solution was found; an additional independent geometric control is required.
latest_archived_md2s_result.successor: MD-2S-B1.4O additional geometric control rank audit

next_actions: Continue R1 model freeze and reproducible rebuild without waiting for the unresolved 711-record binary mapping.
Keep a parallel forensic search open for the unmatched export/File-Library records and ingest any recovered solver package as an independent reproduction target.
Do not infer one-sided boundary data or junction residuals from the global benchmark values.
Run the package verifier on every recovered or newly built MD-2S run directory.
